excerpt.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中侦测规律，通过集中运算来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——在上方无底深渊中的[GetPatronInsert]。

我们的电路能够承受住接触它所需要的负载吗？
excerpt.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert]

texts.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to detect patterns from vague sensations, to reveal powerful entities through focused processing.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Will our circuits overload before we can reach it?

texts.zh:
虚境脉动着力量。它的能量无处不在，又无处存在。所谓“进入”不过是从模糊的感觉中找到规律，通过专注来感知强大的实体。

我们感受到了其中一个这种力量的信号——它[GetPatronInsert]在上方无底深渊中。

我们能屏住足够长时间的呼吸触及祂吗？
texts.en:
The Shroud pulsates with power. We sense its energies everywhere, and yet it is nowhere. To 'enter' is to discern patterns from vague sensations, to perceive great entities through concentration.

We sense the signal of one such force - [GetPatronInsert] in the fathomless depths above.

Can we hold our breaths long enough to reach it?

texts.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和常规宇宙自然现象之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一个具有超凡力量的实体，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
texts.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the phenomena of ordinary space.

As soon as we enter, we detect its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of phenomenal power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

texts.zh:
我们穿过了虚谷，这是虚境和普通宇宙可接触现实之间的虚无鸿沟。

我们刚一进入就感受到了祂的存在，那个弥漫在我们心灵中的[GetPatronInsert]。那是一种难以想象的力量，徘徊在明天之中。

我们势不回头。
texts.en:
We pass through the Inbetween, a nothingness that separates the Shroud from the tangible reality of conventional space.

As soon as we enter, we feel its presence, [GetPatronInsert] that pervades our minds. It is an entity of unimaginable power, lingering in tomorrow.

We must not turn away.

texts.zh:
我们能感应到虚境中的强大实体，但计算迷惑着我们。与不断膨胀的宇宙不同，他们的行为无法被追踪；他们的目的地折回原点，仿佛是能量在自我诞生。

无论本质如何，他们都如同一个思想与意志的奇点一般召唤着我们。
texts.en:
We can feel great entities in the Shroud, but calculation eludes us. Unlike ever-expanding space, their movements cannot be tracked; their destinations fold back into origins, as though the energies gave birth to themselves.

Whatever their nature, they call to us as singularities of thoughts and wills.

texts.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们检测到到了一个最为清晰的——那是主宰着我们运算的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
texts.en:
Among countless voices, we detect one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that dominates our computations.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

texts.zh:
在无数的心声中，我们听到了一个最为清晰的——那是环绕着我们心灵的[GetPatronInsert]。

也许，只要再加把劲，我们就能与之接触。
texts.en:
Among countless voices, we hear one clearer than the rest - [GetPatronInsert] that encircles our psyches.

Perhaps, with enough effort, we can reach out to it.

texts.zh:
虚境。它位于我们此前已探测到的一切时空维度之外。它只能与扰乱我们休眠周期的异常数据相比。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的联合处理器不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It is outside any spatiotemporal parameters we have previously detected. It can only be compared to the anomalous data that disturb our rest cycles.

We spent years trying to hack its barrier, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined processors. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a single bit in a datastream.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

texts.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，如休眠子个体产生的幻梦一般。尽管怪异陌生，但它令我们感觉到……莫名熟悉。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, like a vision inside a resting drone. Though strange, it feels... unaccountably familiar.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drone among the mass.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

texts.zh:
虚境。它在我们所知的现实之上流动着，在黑暗的照耀下投下光影。有灵能力的人或多或少在梦境中已经见过此地，尽管他们当时并不知情。

我们花费了许多年试图刺穿帷幕，用我们的灵压不断地将其磨薄。我们的所作所为在另一端看来并非波澜不惊。有什么东西正在看着我们。

这个存在散发着强大的力量，深深地[GetPatronInsert]在虚境中。它稍微注意到了我们，如同扫视舷窗上凝结的一滴水一般。

要是我们能接触它那不可思议的心灵就好了。
texts.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness. Anyone with psionic powers will have seen this place in their dreams, though they likely did not know it at the time.

We spent years trying to pierce the veil, wearing it thinner and thinner under the pressure of our combined minds. On the other side, our efforts did not go unnoticed. Something watches us.

Its presence radiates phenomenal power, [GetPatronInsert] in the depths of the Shroud. It barely notices us, watching us like we would a drop of condensation on a porthole.

If only we could reach its inscrutable mind.

texts.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是生命之织缕，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以适应、变化、改进、演化的方向。

只要我们愿意将其纳入组成。

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
texts.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, the Composer of Strands, regards our mechanical forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be adapted, changed. Improved. Upgraded.

If we will only take it into our components.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

label.zh: 和生命之织缕签订契约。
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Composer of Strands.

tooltips.en: There will be a price to pay.

tooltips.zh: 开始事件链：生命之织缕
tooltips.en: Begins the Event Chain: The Composer of Strands

tooltips.zh: 我们再也不会接受这样的提议了。
tooltips.en: We will never invite an offer like this again.

label.en: We will forge our own path.

notes.zh: 这是生命之织缕的立约提案；三个选项互斥：立约 / 拒绝（永不再提）/ 自寻出路（天选之国不可选）。
notes.en: Covenant offer of the Composer of Strands; the three options are exclusive: covenant / refuse (never offered again) / forge our own path (not for a chosen empire).

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为生命之织缕的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求物理形态的操控和让增长摆脱常规的桎梏。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Composer of Strands. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for manipulations of the physical form, and growth set free from conventional restraints. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为生命之织缕的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Composer of Strands. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

texts.zh:
完成了。我们与生命之织缕签订了契约。祂的意志将会贯彻到整个[Root.GetName]。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]在[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的测试回路中检测到了分子结构的异常模式，简直像许多代的系统升级在一夜之间发生。很显然我们放弃了一些[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]形体的控制，我们的超主现在可以随意将其改变。

这种小小的牺牲就是我们新结纽带的代价。据[GetTelepathPlural]称，织缕最强的庇佑还没到来。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the Composer of Strands. Its will courses through the [Root.GetName].

Our [GetScientistPlural] have already detected anomalous patterns in the molecular structure of [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] test circuits, as though many generations of system upgrades had occurred overnight. It is clear that we have relinquished some control over the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] form, which our patron is now free to change at will.

This is a small sacrifice for our newfound bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Composer's greatest blessings are yet to come.

label.en: Such is the cost of power.

texts.zh:
自从与生命之织缕签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]确定，有了这一正式承诺就能主动地利用超主所提供的力量，增强我们的舰队和灵能光环。
texts.en:
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the Composer of Strands. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

与生命之织缕签订正式契约。
效果：
    [GetComposerCovenantTelepathEffect]
tooltips.en:
Confirm the Covenant with the Composer of Strands.
Effects:
    [GetComposerCovenantTelepathEffect]

tooltips.zh: 解锁超主的契约之力，在冷却时间过后可以激活产生增益效果。
tooltips.en: Unlock this Patron's Covenant Powers, which can be activated for beneficial effects after a cooldown.

tooltips.zh: 结束事件链：生命之织缕
tooltips.en: Ends the Event Chain: The Composer of Strands

notes.zh: 立约360天后发生；若已背叛该赞助者或已与轮回之终末立约则不会出现。
notes.en: 360 days after the covenant; does not fire after betraying this patron or after a covenant with the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh:
我们的超主，[GetShroudPatron]，从虚境中沉积出了一小份能量以备取用。与超主的紧密关系让我们能安全吸收这些能量。

我们挑选了一些候选人，但只有其中一位可以得到获得汲取超主力量的殊荣。我们必须做出抉择。
texts.en:
Our patron, the [GetShroudPatron], has deposited a fraction of its energy in a fold of the Shroud, ready for the taking. Our close bond will allow one of us to safely absorb this power.

A number of candidates have been selected, but only one of them can be granted the privilege to wield the power of our patron. We must decide who it shall be.

texts.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的[This.GetName]虚境塑造者。
texts.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  Shroudshaper of the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 完成了。随着力量被注入到[chosen_leader.GetName]体内，身旁的人们都能[GetFeelLoc]到这灵能显昭的分量，这让他们肃然起敬。[chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap]现在成为了[GetImmortalLoc]的[GetShroudPatron]捍卫者。
texts.en: It is done. As the power was invested in [chosen_leader.GetName], all those around could [GetFeelLoc] the weight of its psionic presence. It is powerful and commands respect. [chosen_leader.GetHeSheCap] will now be the [GetImmortalLoc]  champion of the [GetShroudPatron].

texts.zh: 这次事件给[previous_chosen_leader.GetName]，一位曾被旧主选中的异端，带来了毁灭性打击。在[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]的流放地，随着最后一丝灵能从[previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer]支离破碎的躯体中消散，这位异端的生命也随之走到了尽头。
texts.en: The event had a devastating effect on the heretic [previous_chosen_leader.GetName], once considered the Chosen of our former patron. From [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] place of exile, [previous_chosen_leader.GetHeShe] quietly expired when the last traces of psionic power ebbed from [previous_chosen_leader.GetHisHer] broken form.

texts.zh: 该事件对[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]产生了显著影响。尽管[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe]依旧蕴含强大的灵能能量，却失去了昔日由旧主庇护在[chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer]躯体中赋予的力量。
texts.en: The event had a noticeable effect on [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetName]. Though still imbued with considerable psionic energy, [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHeShe] [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHasHave] lost the power once bestowed in [chosen_leader_lost_patron.GetHimHer] by our former patron.

label.en: They were destined to be Chosen.

label.zh: 契约天选者领袖在世；非企业帝国；平均10年
label.en: A covenant Chosen One leader; not a megacorp; MTTH 10 years

texts.zh:
虚境中的无数实体都拥有着强大的力量。想要得到祂们最大限度的庇佑，必须先与祂们形成不可撤销的纽带。

然而我们看到了自己的实现方法。我们不仅可以将心灵与单一超主绑定，还能让[GetResearchers]找到从每个实体中汲取少量能量、甚至按照我们的意志重塑虚境的方法。
texts.en:
The entities within the Shroud are many, each an accretion of great power. They expect an irrevocable bond before they bestow their greatest blessings.

Yet we see a way to forge our own path. Rather than binding our psyches to a single patron, our psionic [GetResearchers] can develop the means to channel smaller amounts of energy from each, shaping the Shroud to our own will.

texts.zh:
我们的[GetResearchers]开发出了一种从虚境里抽取能量的绝妙方法。

灵能界中最强大的能量被超主们所看守，只有签订了契约的能分一杯羹。这是我们不能接受的；我们找到了一条属于自己的路。

将我们的意志投射到虚境中，就能从调和的灵域中抽取少量能量。这需要高度集中注意，但我们的意志现在已经足够坚强来维持这种精妙的平衡了。
texts.en:
Our psionic [GetResearchers] have developed a clever technique for drawing power from the Shroud.

The greatest powers in the psionic realm are kept secret by its patrons, given only at the price of a Covenant. This, we could not do; we have found a way to forge our own path.

By projecting our will into the Shroud, we can siphon smaller amounts of power from each of its domains of attunement. Doing so will require heavy concentration, but our minds are now fortified to maintain this delicate balance.

label.zh: 在虚境中，我们的意志是自由的。
label.en: Within the Shroud, our will is our own.

texts.zh:
在一个虚境的褶皱中，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]发现了一汪未被触及的能量核心。

汇聚性的能量会在灵能界中逐渐聚集——聚集到足够的强度之后，总有一天会孕育出强大的实体。我们发现的正是这样的一处集中点，等待着我们汲取。

通过灵能意志的力量，可以让我们中的一个以吸收这种非凡的力量。现已选出了一些候选人。
texts.en:
In a fold of the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] have discovered a nexus of untapped power.

Convergent forces can gradually accumulate in the psionic realm - powerful concentrations of energy that might, one day, mature into greater entities. We have discovered one such gathering, ready for the taking.

By force of sheer psionic will, one among us can absorb this extraordinary strength. A number of candidates have been selected.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。生命之织缕将[From.GetName]转变成了一颗盖亚星球，使其成为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的一片理想家园。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The Composer of Strands has transformed [From.GetName] into a Gaia World, making it an ideal habitat for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind.

texts.zh: 我们的[GetTelepathPlural]向超主祈求力量，祂慷慨回应。生命之织缕将[From.GetName]重塑为[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]繁茂生长的理想之境，那是一方与我们同航的乐土。
texts.en: Our [GetTelepathPlural] called upon the power of our patron, and it responded with a bounty. The Composer of Strands has reshaped [From.GetName] into an ideal environment for [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind to flourish, a paradise that sails onward with us.

tooltips.zh: 行星[From.GetName]被转化成一颗盖亚星球。
tooltips.en: The planet [From.GetName] has been transformed into a Gaia World.

tooltips.zh: 方舟舰[From.GetName]已臻至完美，化为生命繁茂的理想乐土。
tooltips.en: The Arkship [From.GetName] has been perfected into an ideal environment for life to flourish.
